# Pixel-space control (auto-generated by lwti/eval/pixel_control.py)

500 iam test lines, the same lines and damaged images as invariance.py. pix_cos = mean cosine similarity between clean and damaged input pixels (ink = 1); pix_corr = the same with each line's mean removed.
